visualCharacteristics.purpose: TAP's info alert: an important note in a light blue box that the visitor can close
traits: light info-blue box with a 4 px blue edge at the left
info icon beside the title and the text
close button at the top right, closed for the page view only

contentPattern.structure: One cell: a heading (H4) and its text or list.

usage: www.flytap.com's 'Informação importante' alerts (check-in information, insurance, time to think and others).
reuseGuidance: TAP only. For a plain grey note use the section style highlight.
